status: session E3a (teacher pilot and generation) launching 2026-10-19; E3b (train and evaluate) after it
dataset_version: v3 pool and dev split (fingerprint f102ed1e8991077c); weak set data/e3 (1,418 pool questions the base got wrong in E2's generation: 952 MedQA, 466 MedMCQA)
